references.text: The Lord warns Moses that the people must not push forward to look, or many of them will die. The same principle applies: it is deadly to see what is holy without permission.
God tells Moses that no one can see His face and live. This underscores the danger of seeing what is holy.
The Lord struck down the men of Beth-Shemesh because they looked into the ark of the Lord. This illustrates the consequence of looking at what is holy unlawfully.
Uzzah died when he touched the ark. It shows the seriousness of handling what is holy in the wrong way.
The Kohathites were not to touch the holy things, or they would die. The same context regarding how the Levites handled the sanctuary.
Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord's presence. An example of the death penalty for approaching what is holy incorrectly.
